name: vendor-admin-role-aware-ui
scope: vendor-web, api-client, shared-ui, and response compatibility

cases: canonical platform roles and legacy PLATFORM_AUTHOR normalize to one capability vocabulary
unsupported vendor roles do not persist a vendor session or redirect into /admin
authenticated users without a required route role receive a forbidden state
platform user list serializes page and size
platform user role and status filters serialize on the server-owned endpoint
platform user create, role update, suspend, and endpoint methods preserve HTTP contract
legacy and canonical task-type routes remain separate
task-type submit-approval and approve commands use the canonical route
platform admin sees all navigation and privileged actions
platform manager sees operational pages but not settings, platform users, raw license reveal, or revoke
academic manager sees academic review/activation actions
academic staff sees academic create/edit/submit actions but not approve/publish
task-type lifecycleStatus is exposed to the API client
legacy QuestionTypeResponse constructor callers continue to compile
platform user filters are accepted without changing the existing unfiltered list overload

deferred: browser role-by-role navigation and action automation
live HTTP 401/403 checks through a running deployment
production PostgreSQL/Flyway and full seeded regression
